97% of Uruguay’s electricity now comes from clean sources — and the transition that made it possible created around 50,000 jobs, roughly 3% of the country’s entire workforce.

That’s what one decision can set in motion.

Stories like Uruguay’s are unfolding worldwide, powered by governments, communities, and businesses working together. The next generation has the talent to drive the next chapter — what they need is the knowledge, skills, and platform to step in.

So we’re meeting young people where they already are.

Through the NextGen Energy Champions Initiative — a partnership between UNDP and Goodwall — youth aged 16 to 30, anywhere in the world, can use gamified learning on the Goodwall platform to:

→ Watch curated videos on clean energy technology, policy, and careers

→ Complete knowledge quizzes

→ Record a 30-second video sharing their perspective on #CleanEnergy

Because a just energy transition isn’t built for young people. It’s built with them.

Aged 16 to 30? Download Goodwall and take on the challenge.

Work with youth? Please share this post.
